name: dbmason
description: A lightweight, self-hosted database access control plane built with Payload.

scripts.build: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./build-control.db NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=2048" next build
scripts.check: pnpm run generate:types && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:lines && pnpm run check:third-party-provenance && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.dev: cross-env NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation node --require dotenv/config ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev
scripts.dev:app-test: cross-env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.app-test NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation node --require dotenv/config ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev
scripts.devsafe: rm -rf .next && cross-env NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation node --require dotenv/config ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev
scripts.start: cross-env NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation node --require dotenv/config ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next start
scripts.test: pnpm run test:int && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:postgres: pnpm run postgres:test:up && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation vitest run --config ./vitest.postgres.config.mts
scripts.test:e2e:mysql: pnpm run mysql:test:up && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation playwright test --config=playwright.mysql.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:mvp: pnpm run postgres:test:up && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation playwright test --config=playwright.mvp.config.ts
scripts.test:mysql: pnpm run mysql:test:up && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation vitest run --config ./vitest.mysql.config.mts
